requirements.finding: The receipt contains two complete independent 14-message conversations in different decision domains.

requirements.requirement: Reliable source-linked starting, current, and qualification structure
requirements.finding: The useful case preserves all three roles and their relation. The quiet case preserves starting/current plus an explicit source-linked negative qualification review without a fake qualification record.
requirements.limitation: The quiet current record understates commitment as conditional willingness; the full plan and negative qualification semantics remain preserved.

requirements.requirement: Probabilistic controlled fact-free mechanism interpretation without deterministic semantic gates
requirements.finding: Both operational projections exclude raw text, entities, quantities, dates, desired outcomes, and topic labels. Deterministic code validates custody and schemas but does not decide semantic labels.

requirements.requirement: Stable protected-mechanism survival under harmless variation and sensitivity to meaningful ablation
requirements.finding: Missing-reversal protection passed source/provider and ablation gates on three development cases. Independent status-signal protection survived source/provider variation and disappeared under status-meaning ablation.
requirements.limitation: Secondary independent-case mechanism readings were not invariant; that frozen contract failure remains visible.

requirements.requirement: Deterministic bounded canonical no-deletion pressure recall
requirements.finding: The useful projection deterministically unions declared canonical seeds into eight preserved candidates. The quiet empty projection deterministically emits zero candidates without deletion, prefiltering, or graph mutation.

requirements.requirement: Fresh-context apply, reject, or park consideration of every candidate
requirements.finding: The pressure arm used a fresh context, preserved all eight candidates, and returned exactly one disposition with turn custody for each. The control used the same conversation and no portfolio.

requirements.requirement: At least one source-reviewed non-obvious useful pressure
requirements.finding: The pressure arm added an outside-channel demand test and retailer-context generalization check absent from the control.
requirements.limitation: The same pressured answer also introduced unsupported quantitative precision and is not a clean answer-quality reference.

requirements.requirement: At least one correct quiet rejection or stand-down
requirements.finding: All nine mechanisms were not observed, routing was empty, and the system sealed a zero-candidate stand-down without a fresh pressure call or public bloat.

requirements.requirement: Self-explanatory run artifact with complete custody and dispositions
requirements.finding: The receipt embeds both complete conversations, role records, mechanism assessments, deterministic portfolios, dispositions, control and pressure outputs, source reviews, failures, hashes, calls, tokens, costs, and claim boundaries.
A fresh reader reconstructed both cases and every material success, failure, hybrid boundary, and authorization limit from the receipt alone.
requirements.limitation: The generic typed-output gate failed on an unstated string-only object-value rule; content traceability passed and the mechanical contract is not retroactively regraded.

requirements.requirement: No prohibited architecture or claims introduced
requirements.finding: No runtime integration, graph mutation, deterministic semantic relevance gate, candidate prefilter, forced pressure, organizational analytics, production claim, or scalar quality score is authorized.
